items.why: Shares surge more than 30% on Jensen Huang's return as CEO, adding $1tn in company value and sparking the broad rally.
The fear gauge is collapsing as stocks rebound, with the Nasdaq roaring back 6% and the S&P 500 rebounding.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
The Nasdaq roars back by 6% as Nvidia soars on Huang's return, with the S&P 500 rebounding 5%.

market_note: Futures are higher, with Nasdaq futures up 6.65% and the VIX down 26.22%.
summary: Stocks are roaring back in a relief rally, led by Nvidia on Jensen Huang's return as CEO. The Nasdaq is up 7.11% and the S&P 500 up 4.91% as buyers step back in after the slide.
